Name: StonerVille Mod
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[left][center][size=6][b]🌿✨ StonerVille ✨🌿[/b][/size]
[i]A cozy, magical marijuana-themed expansion for Stardew Valley 1.6[/i] 💚

[size=6][b][color=#ffe14d]🚧 STILL A WORK IN PROGRESS! 🚧[/color][/b][/size]
[size=5][b]🗓️ New content & updates arrive EVERY MONTH! 🗓️[/b][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]🌈 WHAT IS IT?[/b][/size]
Grow 8 custom strains 🌱, process them in 13 hand-drawn machines ⚙️, roll joints 🚬, press rosin 🍯, show off your stash 🫙, and even share a joint with the villagers 🫶

💰 [b]Always affordable:[/b] seeds 20-45g, machines 150-350g at Pierre's.

[line]

[size=5][b]📋 REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
[*]🧩 [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.x[/url][/*]
[*]📦 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*]🎮 Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
📁 ONE download, ONE folder: [b]StonerVille_AllInOne[/b] (content pack + add-on). Drop the whole folder into Mods!

[line]

[size=5][b]🌱 THE GROW LOOP[/b][/size]
🌱 Plant → 🌿 Harvest → ☀️ Dry on a Rack → 🫙 Cure in a Jar → 💨 Smoke it, 💰 sell it, or ✨ craft something better![/*]
[*]🍃 [b]8 strains:[/b] Northern Lights, Girl Scout Cookies, Pineapple Express, Blue Dream, Lemon Haze, Strawberry Cough, Sunset Sherbet, Chocolate Mint[/*]
[*]🍫 [b]Chocolate Mint[/b] is the rare one. Its seeds unlock at Dealer Rep 3![/*]
[*]🌸 Fresh, Dried & Cured buds for every strain. Cured buds sell for 1.5x more![/*]
[*]📦 [b]Batch processing:[/b] Racks, Jars, the Rosin Press & the Rolling Table take your whole stack. N in, N out (20 / 10 / 6 / 4 / 2 / 1)

[line]

[size=5][b]⚙️ MACHINES & ITEMS[/b][/size][/*]
[*]🪜 [b]Drying Rack & Dark Wood Rack[/b] · 150g[/*]
[*]🫙 [b]Curing Jar[/b] · 250g[/*]
[*]🫧 [b]Bong & Pastel Bong[/b] · 350g[/*]
[*]🍪 [b]Edibles Oven[/b] · 150g (Brownie, Cookie, Gummies, Tea)[/*]
[*]🌈 [b]Hippie & Pastel Seed Makers[/b] · 150g (bud in, seeds out)[/*]
[*]🫙 [b]Stash Jar[/b] · 200g (a storage jar you can carry with its contents)[/*]
[*]📚 [b]Stash Shelf & Lilac Stash Shelf[/b] · 250g (display 4 jars each)[/*]
[*]🍯 [b]Rosin Press[/b] · 300g (cured buds to Rosin, sells 400g)[/*]
[*]🧈 [b]Infusion Pot[/b] · 200g (1 dried bud + 1 Milk = Cannabutter, sells 150g, reserved for future edibles)[/*]
[*]💎 [b]Dab Rig & Pastel Dab Rig[/b] · 350g (load Rosin, get a Dab Hit buff)[/*]
[*]🪑 [b]Rolling Table[/b] · 200g & 📜 [b]Rolling Papers[/b] · 20g

[line]

[size=5][b]🚬 ROLL YOUR OWN[/b][/size][/*]
[*]🌿 [b]8 Strain Joints:[/b] one per strain from dried buds, each with its own look & a 4 minute buff[/*]
[*]🍂 [b]Blunt:[/b] 2 cured buds, a big 10 minute buff (sells 450g)[/*]
[*]🍫 [b]Dealer's Special:[/b] 2 cured Chocolate Mint, the best there is (sells 900g)[/*]
[*]🎁 [b]Pre-roll Pack:[/b] 5 joints in a tube (sells 700g)

[line]

[size=5][b]🫶 SHARE A JOINT[/b][/size]
Hold a joint, blunt or Dealer's Special and interact with an adult villager (🖱️ mouse & keyboard OR 🎮 controller).[/*]
[*]💖 Some LOVE it (+60 friendship)[/*]
[*]😊 Some join in (+30 friendship, the item's buff, smoke effect)[/*]
[*]🙅 Some politely decline (nothing lost!)[/*]
[*]👀 Joiners get a touch of redness in their eyes on the portrait, during their reply only[/*]
[*]🏔️ Includes Stardew Valley Expanded & Ridgeside Village villagers[/*]
[*]🚫 Kids & teens are never involved. Once per villager per day.

[line]

[size=5][b]☁️ SCREEN SMOKE EFFECT[/b][/size]
Smoke anything and fluffy clouds sweep across your screen with twinkling sparkles ✨ for about 5 seconds, then fade away.

[size=5][b]🕶️ WEARABLES[/b][/size][/*]
[*]🌈 [b]Hippy Glasses[/b] · 150g (rainbow lenses on your farmer!)[/*]
[*]🧥 [b]Hemp Hoodie & Pastel Hoodie[/b] · 200g

[line]

[size=5][b]🛠️ INSTALL[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Install SMAPI & Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]🗑️ DELETE any old [b]Mods/StonerVille[/b] and [b]Mods/StonerVilleGlasses[/b] folders first![/*]
[*]Unzip & drop [b]StonerVille_AllInOne[/b] into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Play & shop at Pierre's! 🛒

[size=5][b]📝 NOTES[/b][/size][/*]
[*]🚧 Work in progress, updated [b]every month[/b]. Suggestions welcome in the comments! 💬[/*]
[*]🧩 Glasses, Stash Jar/Shelf, smoke effect & Share a Joint use the included add-on. If one fails, only that feature turns off.[/*]
[*]🔍 If a villager doesn't react, check the SMAPI log. Unlisted adults politely decline.

[center]💚 Made with love by [b]Nesryn Astra Rose[/b] 💚[/center]
[/*]
[/left]

Manifest.Name: StonerVille Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds eight weed-style crops (Northern Lights, Girl Scout Cookies, Pineapple Express, Blue Dream, Lemon Haze, Strawberry Cough, Sunset Sherbet and the rare Chocolate Mint) with seeds sold at Pierre's, a Drying Rack, a Curing Jar and a Bong with a smoke animation, dealer letters and orders from villagers, and an Edibles Oven that cooks cured buds into brownies, cookies, gummies and tea. Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and Almanac mods.
Manifest.Author: Nesryn Astra Rose

Manifest.Name: StonerVille Glasses
Manifest.Description: Add-on for StonerVille: draws the Hippy Glasses ring on your farmer, makes the Stash Jar hold items, adds the Stash Shelf, and plays the cloud and sparkle smoke effect when you smoke, and adds Share a Joint.
Manifest.Author: Nesryn Astra Rose
